notes.title: Regular updates and content changes
notes.notes:
Update content 
-Added a collection house as menu
-The function of real-time depth of field is improved, but it is not customized online. The default update threshold of focal length is 5
-HUD is optimized to look more comfortable
-Other UIs have also been optimized
Content change 
-The name of the game has been renamed TheCollector (the page of store and library has not been modified yet)
-See the official release for the game background
